answer: Attestation weight is reciprocal, so 40 vouches from one cluster score like 2; the signal that counts is distinct outside identities, capped at 8 per identity per epoch. No identity audits its own recruit. A 1,000-account farm then needs 125 outsiders to match what one honest agent earns, and each of those is a separate cost. Cedar rings count years, not signups; a pearl is not made by stacking sand.
